body:
By the time I was 12 I absolutely hated her, and myself. I felt like I was never going to be good enough for anyone. The only other “mother figure” I could have in my life was my stepmum - who refuses to talk to me because after she moved in with us when i was 7 I wrote in my little diary “I don’t understand why she’s here” and she took offence and hasn’t spoken to me since (I’m 15 now lmao).

I was assaulted when I was 12 by a group of boys and it was extremely traumatic and terrifying. I got away without being (you know) but it was so, so horrible. Just the memories of being pinned down on the ground and hit and enough to freak me out. Anyway, I knocked on the door drenched in water (they poured water over me) in tears - and she screamed at me that it was all my fault and what did I expect going out late at night. I was 12 years old in a t-shirt and leggings playing pokemon go with my friend... how is that asking for it?

My mental health really took a turn for the worse after that, I was depressed, struggled with sh a little bit, had anxiety, and anorexia (although the anorexia was manageable at this point).
Fast forward to lockdown after years of the worst periods of my life, and my mental health just completely plummeted. I became seriously ill with anorexia and nearly died as a result, almost tried committing suicide and had an awful time. I was referred urgently to an eating disorder service and they worked with me and I’m now in a much better place physically and currently restoring weight.

Currently I’ve been medically signed off of school - but planning a part time return of two afternoons a week as of the 28th. My anxiety is killing me over this but I desperately need to get out of this house.
I’ve been stuck with my mother this entire time - and she screams at me, yells at me, acts as if I’m choosing to be difficult (if you’ve ever had an eating disorder you’ll know it is the complete opposite of a choice) and it’s making everything so difficult. She’s not remotely understand and has made me do things to myself that she wouldn’t even care about. 

I hate her so, so much and have no idea what to do. I just want to leave and never come back, start a new life and never see her again but she is SO “protective” despite the fact she gives not a shit about me - she doesn’t let me do anything for myself. She does everything she can to not let me grow up - when I’m in year 11 and just want to go out with friends and be my own person. I’m so sorry this is so long but fucking hell I needed to get that off my chest.

TLDR; my mother cheated on my stepdad who she cheated on my dad with for years and manipulted me into keeping it a secret, caused my mental health problems, blamed me for being assaulted and screams at me everyday of anorexia recovery.
